title: SAP Recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for Talent Acquisition (Recruiting) Suites
summary: SAP SuccessFactors earned Gartner's Customers' Choice for talent acquisition in 2026, recognized across 293 verified customer reviews.
body_markdown:
As AI reshapes the workforce, organizations are rethinking what it means to hire well. The question is no longer how to automate recruiting, it’s how to achieve better hiring outcomes: the fastest path from application to offer, the right talent for the organization, and a workforce that moves with the business.


The strongest proof that SAP is helping organizations achieve those outcomes comes from the recruiters, hiring managers, and talent leaders who rely on our solutions every day.


Experience an AI-first applicant tracking system built for any hiring need


[Learn more](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/recruiting-software.html)


That’s why we’re pleased to share that **SAP has been recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the**[2026 Gartner Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for Talent Acquisition (Recruiting) Suites](https://www.gartner.com/en/documents/8582773) . This distinction is based on verified end-user reviews and reflects customer ratings for Overall Experience and User Interest and Adoption relative to market averages. Across a consideration period that included 293 peer reviews, we believe it captures the experiences of the teams using our solutions to hire, develop, and grow their workforce.


## **What our customers are saying**


Beyond the headline, what matters most is what customers are telling us. These reviews are grounded in the real-world experiences of customers that rely on SAP SuccessFactors solutions to support their talent acquisition and workforce strategies.


## **Building momentum in talent acquisition**


This comes on the heels of another milestone. Earlier this year, SAP was named a[Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employees](https://news.sap.com/2026/09/sap-leader-gartner-magic-quadrant-hcm-suites-1000-employees/) . SAP is the only vendor recognized as both a Magic Quadrant Leader and a Customers’ Choice in the HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employees market and the Talent Acquisition market in 2026.


Together, we believe these results speak to the strength of our SAP SuccessFactors portfolio and the momentum we’re building in talent acquisition as organizations look to connect hiring decisions more closely with workforce strategy. The need for this connected approach is becoming increasingly urgent. Research from[SAP’s Future of Work Research Lab](https://www.sap.com/documents/1354428) found that 88% of executives believe redesigning work and roles creates significant value, yet many still struggle to translate AI investments into workforce transformation.


At the center of this shift is[SmartRecruiters for SAP SuccessFactors](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/recruiting-software.html) . By combining AI-enabled recruiting capabilities with the breadth of SAP SuccessFactors solutions, we’re helping organizations move beyond transactional hiring to a more connected approach that aligns talent acquisition with skills, workforce planning, learning, and employee development.


## **Talent acquisition in the age of Autonomous HCM**


As organizations navigate workforce transformation, skills disruption, and the growing impact of AI, they need workforce decisions grounded in business context. This is the vision behind[Autonomous HCM](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm.html) : empowering people with greater insight, productivity, and decision support across the employee lifecycle.


At[SAP Connect](https://news.sap.com/2026/10/sap-accelerates-autonomous-hcm/) , we showcased new AI-driven capabilities, agents, and experiences across SAP SuccessFactors solutions that help organizations move faster and make more informed decisions. By connecting people, work, skills, and business priorities, SAP helps organizations build the workforce capabilities they need to execute their strategy.


Talent acquisition is critical to this vision. With SmartRecruiters for SAP SuccessFactors, we’re moving from AI as a tool people operate to AI that works proactively—with people firmly in control. The goal: better hiring decisions and the fastest path from application to offer.


## **Learn more**


Explore the[2026 Gartner Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for Talent Acquisition (Recruiting) Suites](https://www.gartner.com/en/documents/8582773) (registration required) and find out what enterprise customers are saying across the talent acquisition market. Learn more about[SmartRecruiters for SAP SuccessFactors](https://www.sap.com/products/hcm/recruiting-software.html) and our vision for the future of talent acquisition.


---


Harriet Newlyn is chief revenue officer at SAP SuccessFactors.
